speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have a psychiatric condition and new movement issues; to help me determine the cause, can you tell me which specific movement symptoms you are experiencing, such as tremors, rigidity, or involuntary jerking?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful. Since you are taking risperidone, can you describe exactly where and how the movement issue occurs, and does it stop when you are sleeping?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced acute dystonia (specifically akathisia) secondary to risperidone.
